findings.summary: claudeResponse.Usage dereferenced without nil check in HandleClaudeResponseData; the old completion path was safe (used info.PromptTokens + CountTextToken) but this safe path is removed, making the nil-dereference risk unconditional
findings.failure_scenario: An API response (e.g., from AWS Bedrock with a malformed or edge-case response) that passes the error check but has no usage field will cause a nil pointer panic on claudeResponse.Usage.InputTokens.

findings.summary: claudeResponse.Delta.Text accessed in FormatClaudeResponseInfo without checking that claudeResponse.Delta itself is non-nil for content_block_delta events
findings.failure_scenario: A stream event of type content_block_delta with a nil Delta pointer (malformed or unexpected API response) causes a nil pointer dereference panic when accessing claudeResponse.Delta.Text.

findings.summary: claudeResponse.Delta.StopReason dereferenced in StreamResponseClaude2OpenAI without nil-checking claudeResponse.Delta or StopReason for message_delta events
findings.failure_scenario: A message_delta stream event with a nil Delta or a nil StopReason pointer crashes with a nil pointer dereference at stopReasonClaude2OpenAI(*claudeResponse.Delta.StopReason).

findings.summary: ResponseText2Usage error is silently discarded (claudeInfo.Usage, _ = ...) and the result is dereferenced (*claudeInfo.Usage) on the next line when ShouldIncludeUsage is true, risking nil pointer panic if token counting fails
findings.failure_scenario: If service.ResponseText2Usage returns an error (e.g., unknown model name), claudeInfo.Usage becomes nil; then helper.GenerateFinalUsageResponse dereferences *claudeInfo.Usage and panics.

findings.summary: Dead code: RequestOpenAI2ClaudeComplete function is defined but has zero callers after the diff removed the only call site in ConvertOpenAIRequest
findings.failure_scenario: The function (approximately 25 lines) is still compiled and shipped, adding unused binary size and maintenance burden. Any future refactor might waste time updating it.

findings.summary: Unused parameter: StreamResponseClaude2OpenAI accepts reqMode int but no longer branches on it; callers in claude/adaptor.go, vertex/adaptor.go, and aws/relay-aws.go still pass values that are ignored
findings.failure_scenario: Future maintainers may spend time tracing what requestMode values are valid and whether the parameter still has meaning, when it no longer affects any code path.

findings.summary: Unused parameter: ResponseClaude2OpenAI accepts reqMode int but never uses it in its body; called from HandleClaudeResponseData with the ignored value
findings.failure_scenario: Same as above -- dead parameter adds confusion for future readers and could mislead someone adding a new branch that checks the mode expecting it to be meaningful.
